precedence: This v5 token supersedes v4 as the effective Auth-lane boundary. It replaces the retired payroll-read helper paths, adds only the exact PAY v49 resolver proof paths, expands the generic-session topology to the exact twelve-route set, and strengthens expression reduction. All unaffected v4 carrier, Gateway, generation, release and validation allowances remain bound by this exact effective path set and their prior conditions.
retiredPathRule: The two uncommitted PayrollSupportElevatedReadAuthorityPolicy paths must be absent from the implementation commit and replaced by the exact PayrollV49ElevatedAuthorityPolicy paths. The previously retired duplicate Gateway test path remains forbidden.
closedSetRule: The backend v49 Auth-lane implementation commit may change only effectiveExactChangedPathClosedSet and must contain none of retiredAndForbiddenPaths. Presence of any other path is a hard denial requiring a new append-only exact-path decision.

requiredBehavior: Only the exact twelve routes may have generic session step-up with no command binding.

A NORMAL challenge is emitted only when an activated branch is decisive; an ALLOWED ANY member or otherwise applicable ALLOWED access-profile alternative on the exact grandfathered routes wins without challenge, while explicit selector and blocking-denial rules remain intact.
A generic challenge never forwards to an owner service and never returns a protected payload.
ELEVATED performs complete exact reevaluation and does not inherit a NORMAL result.
No owner, target, expected-version or command binding may be synthesized for a generic route.

expressionReductionException.canonicalization: Expression members and winning evidence are reduced in unique ascending capability-contract-key order. Duplicate, missing, blank or unregistered members fail closed. Input declaration order must not affect decision, reason, grants, scopes or selected challenge evidence.
requiredSemantics: ANY with an ALLOWED alternate never challenges merely because another branch is activated.
ANY challenges only when no branch allows and at least one exact activated branch returns STEP_UP_REQUIRED.
ALL hard-denies if any branch hard-denies; otherwise it challenges if any branch requires step-up; otherwise all branches must allow.
ELEVATED reevaluates the exact expression and every non-activation constraint.
On the exact six grandfathered routes, an applicable ALLOWED access-profile alternative is reduced as an OR alternative before a management STEP_UP_REQUIRED result may become decisive.

payV49ElevatedPolicyException.normalRule: The helper may admit only an exact v49 ELEVATED-only profile as a NORMAL STEP_UP_REQUIRED candidate. It can never return ALLOWED, weaken a predicate or synthesize a route/binding.
payV49ElevatedPolicyException.elevatedRule: ELEVATED authority remains full ordinary policy reevaluation. The helper does not bypass capability, predicate, scope, target, SoD or fresh command evidence.
payV49ElevatedPolicyException.payrollRunDataRule: route.hcm.operations.payroll-run.data is excluded from the helper and remains governed by exact ANY expression reduction.

payV49StepUpResolverException.runtimeRule: Bundle version 49 is added to both the supported step-up runtime set and sealed runtime set. It must be the active stored product-surfaces bundle with a matching active pointer, checksum, schema and seal; drift or ambiguity fails closed.
payV49StepUpResolverException.profileSelectionRule: For challenge resolution only, the resolver may select the unique highest-precedence exact ELEVATED-only direct CAPABILITY profile on route.hcm.operations.payroll-run.action or route.hcm.operations.payroll-run-calculate.action. It may not generalize ELEVATED-only selection to any other route or expression.
payV49StepUpResolverException.fixtureChangeRule: ProductSurfaceStepUpRuntimeSpringFixture may add exactly dwp-payroll-server to its existing test-only allowed-audience set because the two exact bindings require that audience. No wildcard, production setting or service change is admitted.
payV49StepUpResolverException.ambiguityAndDriftRule: A missing, non-ELEVATED-only, non-direct, non-activated, lower/duplicate precedence, wrong predicate, wrong route, wrong binding, wrong audience, wrong target or wrong expected-version contract fails closed before challenge signing.
